notes.summary: In coding-decoding, a word or number is written in a secret code. Find the rule from the given example and apply it. SSC asks 2–3 questions every shift.

concepts.title: Letter shift
concepts.body: Each letter moves forward or backward by a fixed number (CAT → DBU is +1). Write positions A=1 … Z=26 to see the shift. After Z, go back to A.

concepts.title: Pattern coding
concepts.body: The word may be reversed (GARDEN → NEDRAG), letters may be replaced by their opposite letter (A↔Z, B↔Y; positions add to 27), or by their position numbers.

concepts.title: Substitution
concepts.body: Real words stand for other words: "sky is called sea". Answer with the code name of the real answer, not the real word.

varieties.name: Letter shift
varieties.how: Find the shift for each letter from the example; apply the same shift.

example.q: If CAT is DBU, code DOG.

varieties.name: Reverse / opposite / number
varieties.how: Check reversal, opposite letters (sum 27) and positions.

example.q: If LAMP is OZNK, code DESK.

varieties.name: Substitution
varieties.how: Find the real answer, then give its code name.

example.q: If water is called air, what do fish live in?

tips: Check the rule on every letter of the example, not just the first one.
Opposite pairs: A–Z, B–Y, C–X, D–W, E–V, F–U, G–T, H–S, I–R, J–Q, K–P, L–O, M–N.
traps: In substitution, the answer is the code word, not the real word.
When shifting past Z, wrap around to A (Y + 3 = B).

questions.q: In a certain code language, CAT is written as DBU. How will DOG be written in that language?
questions.solution:
C→D, A→B, T→U: each letter +1.
D+1 = E, O+1 = P, G+1 = H.
DOG → EPH.

questions.q: In a certain code, BAD is written as 214. How will FED be written in that code?
questions.solution:
Each letter is replaced by its position: B=2, A=1, D=4.
F=6, E=5, D=4.
FED → 654.

questions.q: In a certain code language, PAPER is written as SDSHU. How will PENCIL be written in that language?
questions.solution:
P→S, A→D, P→S, E→H, R→U: each letter +3.
P+3 = S, E+3 = H, N+3 = Q, C+3 = F, I+3 = L, L+3 = O.
PENCIL → SHQFLO.

questions.q: In a certain code language, GARDEN is written as NEDRAG. How will FLOWER be written in that language?
questions.solution:
GARDEN written backwards is NEDRAG: the word is reversed.
FLOWER reversed = REWOLF.

questions.q: If 'sky' is called 'sea', 'sea' is called 'water', 'water' is called 'air' and 'air' is called 'cloud', then where do fish live?
questions.solution:
Fish live in water.
In this language, water is called 'air'.
So the answer is Air.

questions.q: In a certain code language, LAMP is written as OZNK. How will DESK be written in that language?
questions.solution:
L(12)→O(15), A(1)→Z(26), M(13)→N(14), P(16)→K(11): positions add to 27, so each letter becomes its opposite letter.
D(4)→W(23), E(5)→V(22), S(19)→H(8), K(11)→P(16).
DESK → WVHP.

flashcards.back: Positions add to 27: A–Z, M–N, D–W, K–P
Find the real answer, then reply with its code name.
After Z comes A: X + 4 = B
